scientific_integrity: The all-order classification is supported by direct lemmas, while finite enumeration checks small instances and the exact first threshold. Existing VC and sample-compression results are credited and are not misrepresented as new.
scientific_limitations: Finite, undirected, simple, connected trees and radius-one closed balls only; no claim for larger radii or arbitrary graphs. The eight-vertex isomorphism count uses exhaustive Prüfer enumeration and a canonical-tree algorithm. Historical publication priority remains a residual uncertainty; no independent scientific audit has been performed.
title: A sharp three-level online-shattering law for closed unit balls of finite trees
